structural_change: HBMA-QDQ 10-17: the die-bound ot_hgi_qdq_host_static (IO_REGS=0) is not flop-first: rr feeds the expected-return check (fault) and the 8:1 lane select before any register, fault is a 4-way OR of child registers, rst_n fans out asynchronously to the calendar/transport/decoder. Opt-in PIN_BOUNDARY=1 (two ot_rst_relay collars, sticky fault_q) + IO_REGS=1 (registered rr/y, constant-index lane select; 3e0c10191 priced +2 edges): VM write reservation t+35 -> t+37, read unchanged, LCP->commit 157 -> 159 vs immutable 168. Exact current-RG5-NW bench run_qdq_compact_host_pin_boundary.sh m0 PASS, m1..m7 killed (m7 stale t+35 VM programme -> bank fault). Pins: per-bank faces toward the d4f NW bank peers (io_tcl), program SRAM on the 43.2 lattice, five related roots as bound.
